### SD and filesystem control block

Status bits (`MIA_SD_CONTROL_STATUS`):

| Bit | Mask | Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `%00000001` | `MIA_SD_STATUS_PRESENT` | A card initialized successfully. |
| 1 | `%00000010` | `MIA_SD_STATUS_INITIALIZED` | The SD block driver is initialized. |
| 2 | `%00000100` | `MIA_SD_STATUS_MOUNTED` | The FAT filesystem is mounted. |
| 3 | `%00001000` | `MIA_SD_STATUS_BUSY` | An SD/FS command is in progress. |
| 4 | `%00010000` | `MIA_SD_STATUS_FILE_OPEN` | The slot HANDLE_SELECT names is open. |
| 5 | `%00100000` | `MIA_SD_STATUS_DIR_OPEN` | The directory cursor is open. |
| 6 | `%01000000` | `MIA_SD_STATUS_EOF` | Same condition as the EOF field. |
| 7 | `%10000000` | `MIA_SD_STATUS_ERROR` | LAST_ERROR is nonzero. |

Card types (`MIA_SD_CONTROL_CARD_TYPE`):

| Value | Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `MIA_SD_CARD_NONE` | No initialized card. |
| 1 | `MIA_SD_CARD_SD_V1` | Standard-capacity SD v1 card. |
| 2 | `MIA_SD_CARD_SD_V2` | Standard-capacity SD v2 card. |
| 3 | `MIA_SD_CARD_SDHC` | High-capacity card (SDHC or SDXC) using block addressing. |

Open modes (`MIA_SD_CONTROL_OPEN_MODE`):

| Value | Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `MIA_FS_OPEN_READ` | Open an existing file for reading. |
| 1 | `MIA_FS_OPEN_WRITE_CREATE` | Create or truncate a file for writing. |
| 2 | `MIA_FS_OPEN_WRITE_APPEND` | Create the file if missing and append at its end. |
| 3 | `MIA_FS_OPEN_READ_WRITE` | Open or create a file for updates in place. |
